title: symphoricarpos puniceus
intro: Symphoricarpos puniceus, commonly known as the wolfberry or coralberry, is a deciduous shrub native to eastern North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels and improve lipid profiles, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Symphoricarpos puniceus include its use in treating diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and gastrointestinal disorders. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
